::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_usage"}
#docs
Usage of a meter with a credit cost takes its credits when each event arrives; a settlement then draws them from the customer's credit grants, each hour and in the period invoice, and posts the cost of paid credit as revenue. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1 to 1000. Default 50. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `meter` | `string` | no | Only settlements of this meter. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_usage`. One of `credit_usage`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | cst_… |
| `data.customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `data.meter` | `string` | The meter's id. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The credit unit's id. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | `usage`: events received in the window. `late`: late events that a credit grant paid in its grace window, after it ended. One of `usage`, `late`. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The credit usage's status. One of `settled`. |
| `data.window_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | The credit usage's window start. |
| `data.window_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The credit usage's window end. |
| `data.events` | `integer` | Usage events in the settlement. |
| `data.quantity` | `string` | The usage, in units of the meter. |
| `data.credits_due` | `string` | What the usage costs, in whole credits. |
| `data.credits_drawn` | `string` | What the settlement drew from the credit grants. |
| `data.quantity_uncovered` | `string` | Usage that no credit paid. Only for events that a credit hold covers. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `data.revenue_minor` | `integer` | The cost of the paid credit drawn: the revenue the settlement posted. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit usage was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Send as `starting_after` for the next page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The settlements. |
| `404` | No such customer. |

#request

```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_usage?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
